caption: A shopping trolley rolls along an aisle under a convex security mirror, and its small curved reflection slides across the mirror.

sa.check: A shopping trolley rolls along an aisle under a security mirror.
Its reflection slides across the mirror.
The reflection is small and curved.

pc.expect: The reflection is much smaller than the trolley and bulges with the mirror's curve.
pc.fail: It is life-size; or flat and undistorted on a plainly convex mirror; or a different object.

pc.expect: The reflection moves the same way as the trolley and only then.
pc.fail: It moves the opposite way; or with the trolley still; or stays while the trolley leaves.

pc.expect: The reflection leaves the mirror when the trolley leaves its view.
pc.fail: It stays after; or is missing while the trolley is plainly in view; or appears before.
It ripples; or bends; or goes dull.
A second trolley appears; or the mirror vanishes; or the reflection steps out.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The aisle and the trolley stay the same.
pc.fail: The shelves rearrange; or the trolley changes; or the mirror changes shape.
